limitations: Residual dimensions are not robot collision clearance or allowable positioning error.
Pitch projections exclude translation sweep, clamps, arms, shelf lips, posts and stop.
Reported 0.50 m opening is not yet a measured minimum along the entire insertion.
Friction threshold is idealised, not a measurement or a retention qualification.
A reported minimum disengagement is not an upper bound on required lift.

stages.requirement: Detect top box, approach sides and confirm bimanual grip; no lateral extraction.
Lift vertically without tilt; confirm lower boxes remain supported and upper rim clears.
Only after disengagement; path from registered pile and pallet geometry.
Navigate once to taught pre-rack pose with held-box geometry.
Review approach, rigid bimanual rotation, insertion and support on actual slope.
Release only with stable support and verified retention; do not assume sliding.
Withdraw empty clamps clear of rack before separate HOME.
